name: visual-explainer
description: Use when the user asks to explain a problem, issue, PR, or feature as an infographic. Create a step-by-step visual explanation starting from user code or actions, with a clear problem/solution boundary, syntax-highlighted snippets, and focused diagrams. Support standalone educational PDFs and Markdown-first PR explanations, with optional images only for complex diagrams. Also apply when explicitly invoked by the repository PR writer.
